name: Ferrovial N.V.

ads_ratio.source: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25), cover page, securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b): 'Ordinary shares, par value EUR 0.01 per share', trading symbol FER, 'Nasdaq Global Select Market' — the Nasdaq security is the ordinary share itself, not an ADS
ads_ratio.reason: Ferrovial is a direct-listed foreign private issuer: one Nasdaq-traded FER share is one ordinary share, so no ADS conversion applies; per-share figures and the traded price are on the same basis.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25), Consolidated statements of cash flows, investing activities line 'Investments in property, plant and equipment/intangible assets' (Note 3.4): EUR 187M for FY2025, with EUR 226M for FY2024 and EUR 86M for FY2023 in the same statement (tagged in the filing's inline XBRL under the custom fer:InvestmentsInPropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndIntangibleAssets concept, which EDGAR companyfacts does not carry)
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under every candidate tag the engine reads (no ifrs-full PurchaseOfPropertyPlantAndEquipment concept exists in this filer's companyfacts at all). The engine applies this single FY2025 filing value to every missing period; for FY2023 it overstates true capex (EUR 86M filed) in the conservative direction, for FY2024 it understates it by EUR 39M (EUR 226M filed) — immaterial against OCF of EUR 1,263M-1,926M in those years. Declared in EUR (the reporting currency); the engine FX-converts at period-end ECB rates. Infrastructure-project investments (a separate cash-flow line, EUR 466M in FY2025) are concession growth investments, not PP&E/intangible capex, and are not in this line — see analysis.md.

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25), operating results / personnel expenses breakdown (section 2.3): 'Share-based payments' EUR 14M for FY2025, with EUR 13M for FY2024 and EUR 11M for FY2023 in the same table
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under every candidate tag the engine reads (the filer files no ifrs-full AdjustmentsForSharebasedPayments cash-flow addback; its share-based payment expense is stated in the personnel-expenses breakdown). The engine applies this single FY2025 filing value to every missing period; the FY2023/FY2024 filed values in the same table (EUR 11M / EUR 13M) are the same magnitude, and SBC at this level is ~1% of OCF — immaterial either way. Declared in EUR (the reporting currency); the engine FX-converts at period-end ECB rates.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency EUR converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25), cover page, securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b): 'Ordinary shares, par value EUR 0.01 per share', trading symbol FER, 'Nasdaq Global Select Market' — the Nasdaq security is the ordinary share itself, not an ADS) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25), operating results / personnel expenses breakdown (section 2.3): 'Share-based payments' EUR 14M for FY2025, with EUR 13M for FY2024 and EUR 11M for FY2023 in the same table); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25), Consolidated statements of cash flows, investing activities line 'Investments in property, plant and equipment/intangible assets' (Note 3.4): EUR 187M for FY2025, with EUR 226M for FY2024 and EUR 86M for FY2023 in the same statement (tagged in the filing's inline XBRL under the custom fer:InvestmentsInPropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndIntangibleAssets concept, which EDGAR companyfacts does not carry)); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 2.82 vs 3-yr median 1.61 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
BIG_NET_CASH: net cash is 3.2x normalized OE — part of the price is a cash pile, not the operating business; note it in the verdict

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
